changeSet.author: Tduric
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetPath') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[AssetPath] ( [ID] [bigint] NOT NULL, [Segments] [xml] NULL, [DisplayPath] AS ([dbo].[GetDisplayPath]([Segments],' > ',' / ')) PERSISTED, [KeyPath] AS ([dbo].[GetKeyPath]([Segments])) PERSISTED, [KeyPathHash] AS ([dbo].[GetKeyPathHash]([Segments])) PERSISTED, CONSTRAINT [PK_AssetPath] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.AssetPath', 'KeyPathHash') IS NULL BEGIN alter table [dbo].[AssetPath] add [KeyPathHash] AS ([dbo].[GetKeyPathHash]([Segments])) PERSISTED END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from [sys].[foreign_keys] WHERE name = 'FK_AssetPath_Asset') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetPath] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_AssetPath_Asset] FOREIGN KEY([ID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Asset] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetPath] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_AssetPath_Asset] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.xml_indexes where name = 'IX_AssetPath_Segments_Primary') BEGIN CREATE PRIMARY XML INDEX [IX_AssetPath_Segments_Primary] ON AssetPath ( [Segments] ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.xml_indexes where name = 'IX_AssetPath_Segments_Path') BEGIN CREATE XML INDEX [IX_AssetPath_Segments_Path] ON AssetPath ( [Segments] ) USING XML INDEX [IX_AssetPath_Segments_Primary] FOR PATH END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_AssetPath_DisplayPath') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_AssetPath_DisplayPath] ON [dbo].[AssetPath] ( [DisplayPath] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_AssetPath_KeyPath') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_AssetPath_KeyPath] ON [dbo].[AssetPath] ( [KeyPath] ASC ) END
